text: E ko kamɓe senndata yurmeende Joomi maa nden, an Nulaaɗo, sakko wona ɓe okkay nde mo ɓe yiɗani, ɓe ɗala nde mo ɓe haaji, kaa ko Allah? Awa ko Menen woni ko senndi arsikeeji maɓɓe ɗin hakkunde maɓɓe aduna, Men waɗi e maɓɓe alɗuɓe e waasuɓe, fii no yga maɓɓe wonira eltanaaɓe ɓeya. Haray, ko ko Joomi maa yurmetee jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen kon ka laakara, ɓuri moƴƴude e dii ko ɓee mooɓata e aduna lannoowo on.
